ideas.pitch: A personal finance and expense tracker wrapped inside a hyper-saturated, comic-sans, glitter-injected retro web UI built by a literal toddler.
ideas.title: GooeyGains
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the specific theme of retro-internet chaos on the outside with solid working code underneath. Judges at a playful hackathon will instantly reward the absurdity of a serious financial calculator housed within marquee text tags, giant comic sans fonts, and flashing cursor trails.

ideas.pitch: An AI coding assistant concierge that answers complex programming prompts exclusively in baby talk, complete with loud audio error rattles and flashing primary-color buttons.
ideas.title: BabyGPT
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the allowance of AI coding assistants and the theme of retro-internet chaos by pairing a robust LLM API with an aggressively obnoxious, childish frontend that makes the hackathon theme its core personality.

ideas.pitch: A fully functional Web3 crypto tip jar and micro-transaction app disguised as a baby's Fisher-Price toy interface with oversized clicking blocks.
ideas.title: RattleChain
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fuses serious backend blockchain mechanics with a hilariously unhinged frontend aesthetic, executing on the core hackathon requirement that the code underneath must be completely solid despite the chaotic outside look.

ideas.pitch: A productivity timer and task manager that forces you to play an overly bright, flashing baby game whenever your break ends to unlock your screen.
ideas.title: PeekABooPomodoro
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a useful utility application with deep adherence to the bright colors, oversized buttons, and retro-internet chaos mandate specified by the event organizers.

ideas.pitch: A retro arcade minigame testing real-time event logging, built with loud neon gradients, massive clickable blocks, and sound effects synthesized entirely in-browser.
ideas.title: DiaperDash
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the retro-internet chaos aesthetic perfectly through a self-contained web mini-game that delivers instant visual and auditory feedback, maximizing user engagement during judging demos.
